excerpts.anchor: Serum magnesium levels designating “hypomagnesemia” differ widely. Of 43
marks: Of 43 collected values, only 2 met 0.85 mmol/L as the low cut-off point to define hypomagnesemia.

excerpts.anchor: Widely varying serum magnesium reference ranges render
marks: Widely varying serum magnesium reference ranges render our use of this important medical tool imprecise, minimizing impacts of low magnesium status or hypomagnesemia as a marker of disease risk.

excerpts.until: Two groups of magnesium researchers, one in the United States
marks: serum magnesium reference intervals have been established with “healthy” individuals, including many who unknowingly have CLMD

excerpts.anchor: Forty-three values were gathered from institutions in 16 different countries
marks: Forty-one values of the 43 institutions (95%) designated their low cutoff for definition of hypomagnesemia below and even well below this suggested standard
